README: The facts about this tool that appear in more than one place. Every script in publish/ reads them from here so they can never be typed twice and drift. NOTE: this tool predates the template and carries NO publish/bump-version.mjs, so `--sync` cannot derive manifest.firefox.json from this file. scripts/policy-check.mjs cross-checks the two instead and FAILS if they disagree — see the `gecko.id is derived from identity.json` limb.

NOTES.slug: lowercase, a-z0-9 and hyphens. It is the zip filename (<slug>-<version>.zip) and the local part of the Firefox add-on id. Not shown to users. MUST equal tool.json's id — policy-check fails if it does not.
NOTES.ownerDomain: a domain you actually control. gecko.id is derived as <slug>@<ownerDomain> and AMO fixes the add-on identity at FIRST SIGNING — a placeholder that ships once is a permanently wrong identity, not a fixable typo. Chosen 2026-08-18: nikatru.com, the domain that serves the storefront this extension is catalogued on.
NOTES.supportEmail: goes in the store listing's support field. A real inbox someone reads. This address is already asserted in two other places by the storefront's assert-repo-posture guard (SECURITY.md and sites/nikatru/contact.html), so it is not a new claim.
NOTES.privacyPolicyUrl: DELIBERATELY EMPTY, not forgotten. publish/PRIVACY-POLICY.html is written but NOT HOSTED anywhere, and no store submission can proceed until it is (see PRIVACY-POLICY-HOSTING.md). An empty value says 'not yet'; a plausible-looking URL like https://nikatru.com/fullshot/privacy would 404, which is worse than blank because it reads as done. Fill this in when the file is actually reachable over https with no login.
NOTES.homepageUrl: optional; the storefront that lists this extension.
